title: AlphaFill: enriching the AlphaFold models with ligands and co-factors
authors: Hekkelman ML; de Vries I; Joosten RP; Perrakis A
one_liner_zh: 该文提出AlphaFill算法，通过序列和结构相似性将实验结构中的配体/辅因子移植到AlphaFold预测模型上，虽非直接研究TF-DNA互作，但涉及蛋白-配体结合建模，方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA复合物建模，对课题有借鉴价值。
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) methods for constructing structural models of proteins on the basis of their sequence are having a transformative effect in biomolecular sciences. The AlphaFold protein structure database makes available hundreds of thousands of protein structures. However, all these structures lack cofactors essential for their structural integrity and molecular function (e.g. hemoglobin lacks a bound heme), key ions essential for structural integrity (e.g. zinc-finger motifs) or catalysis (e.g. Ca 2+ or Zn 2+ in metalloproteases), and ligands that are important for biological function (e.g. kinase structures lack ADP or ATP). Here, we present AlphaFill, an algorithm based on sequence and structure similarity, to “transplant” such “missing” small molecules and ions from experimentally determined structures to predicted protein models. These publicly available structural annotations are mapped to predicted protein models, to help scientists interpret biological function and design experiments.
abstract_zh: 基于序列构建蛋白质结构模型的人工智能（AI）方法正在生物分子科学领域产生变革性影响。AlphaFold蛋白质结构数据库提供了数十万个蛋白质结构。然而，所有这些结构都缺乏对其结构完整性和分子功能至关重要的辅因子（例如血红蛋白缺乏结合的血红素）、对结构完整性（例如锌指基序）或催化作用（例如金属蛋白酶中的Ca²⁺或Zn²⁺）至关重要的关键离子，以及对生物功能重要的配体（例如激酶结构缺乏ADP或ATP）。在此，我们提出AlphaFill，一种基于序列和结构相似性的算法，将实验确定的结构中的这些“缺失”小分子和离子“移植”到预测的蛋白质模型上。这些公开可用的结构注释被映射到预测的蛋白质模型上，以帮助科学家解释生物功能并设计实验。
